A.strength: Fully ban-compliant with genuinely art-directed CSS 'staged room' placeholder illustrations, strict 8-hex palette discipline, and exact section order and copy anchors.
A.weakness: CTA/label text runs ~12.5px (below the 14–16px spec with 0.1em instead of 1.5px tracking), and tier ideal-for/rooms lines plus agent feature copy are left as meta-placeholder text instead of crafted lines.

B.strength: Confident editorial rhythm with fully crafted step/tier/pay-at-close copy, working keyboard-accessible slider, and strong persistent conversion paths for both sellers and agents.
B.weakness: H1 clamps to 68px, breaking the 42–56px desktop type anchor; adds off-palette hexes (gold-deep, navy-deep), overshoots CTA tracking (.15em ≈ 2.1px), and relocates the mandated hero sub line into a kicker.

C.strength: Most spec-precise typography (CTAs exactly Montserrat 600 / 14px / 1.5px tracking / uppercase), exact hero sub placement, and honest placeholder discipline throughout.
C.weakness: Placeholder surfaces are simple gradients (less art-directed than A's illustrated rooms), adds off-palette tints (#b8945a, #f2eee6, #eadbbf), and the footer gold CTA loops to #top instead of a contact action.

notes: A wins on ban-proof craft and the most convincing 'staged' placeholder art direction; C is the cleanest type-anchor execution; B is polished but breaks the locked H1 scale and palette.
